start.sendAsAttachmentTitle: Attach the current document to a new email message
start.databaseTitle: Database Studio · Access database as an editable working copy
start.intro: Write, calculate, present and capture ideas.
start.newFileHint: Choose your tool and start with a blank file
start.notesText: Notebooks, sections and pages. Saved locally and automatically.
start.emailText: Your own email via IMAP and SMTP. Attachments open straight in Text, Spreadsheet, Presentation or Database.
start.browseDatabase: Open an MDB or ACCDB database or a SQLite working copy.
start.browseDocuments: Open a document, spreadsheet or presentation.
start.filesStayLocal: Your files stay on your computer.
start.aboutText: DOCX, XLSX and PPTX work directly. With a conversion program set up, the desktop version can also convert ODF and older formats; formatting may differ. Database Studio turns an MDB or ACCDB file into an editable SQLite working copy with tables, queries, forms, reports and VBA; the original stays unchanged. The standalone app can be installed as Open Database Studio.

recovery.title: Recover documents
recovery.explanation: Open Office Studio was not closed properly last time. A recovery copy was kept of these documents. Recovering opens a new, unsaved tab; the original file stays unchanged.
recovery.laterTitle: The copies are kept until the next start
recovery.restoredFrom: Recovered from the recovery copy of {{date}}. The original file has not been changed; save this document to keep it.
recovery.copyFailed: Automatic recovery could not save a copy: {{error}}

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.askSave: Do you want to save the changes to {{name}} before closing it?
leave.unsaved: {{name}} contains changes that have not been saved yet. Save the file first if you want to keep them.
leave.others_one: After that, {{count}} other document with unsaved changes follows.
leave.others_other: After that, {{count}} other documents with unsaved changes follow.

saveAs.title: Save as
saveAs.browserInfo: In the browser the app creates Markdown, CSV, HTML, text and PDF itself, plus PNG for spreadsheets and presentations. Formats marked “desktop app only” need the desktop version with an office runtime.
saveAs.runtimeMissing: No office runtime (LibreOffice) found. Formats that need the runtime are not available.
saveAs.csvInfo: Only the selected sheet, with values instead of formulas. Text starting with =, +, - or @ gets an apostrophe, so that a spreadsheet program does not run it as a formula.
saveAs.protect: Protect with a password to open
saveAs.encryptionInfo: Encryption according to ECMA-376 (AES-256), can be opened in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and LibreOffice. The password is not stored; if you lose it, the file can no longer be opened.
saveAs.noEncryptionInfo: This is not write or sheet protection: without the tick the file is saved unencrypted.
saveAs.printRoute: Without an office runtime, PDF goes via Print: in the print dialogue choose the printer Save as PDF (Windows: “Microsoft Print to PDF”). The layout follows what you see in the editor.
saveAs.copyInfo: This is a copy in another format. The document stays marked as changed until you save it as .{{ext}}.
